description: Nudges toward pstack:poteto-mode as the default entry point for non-trivial engineering tasks. Overridable by direct user instructions or CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md, per the injected text itself. Set env var PSTACK_DISABLE_SESSION_HOOK=1 to disable this hook entirely. Set PSTACK_SESSION_HOOK_FILE to an absolute path to inject that file's text instead.
